description: This file defines the implementation of the OpenwrtControlServer class, which is a CommandSource for managing OpenWRT control server commands within the Cuttlefish project. It includes methods for creating commands to start the server with specific parameters and integrates with the dependency injection framework (Fruit).

classes.name: OpenwrtControlServer
classes.description: A CommandSource implementation that manages the startup commands for the OpenWRT control server, including configuration and command creation based on the Cuttlefish environment.

methods.name: Commands
methods.description: Generates and returns a list of commands to start the OpenWRT control server with specific parameters.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name identifier for this CommandSource.

methods.name: Enabled
methods.description: Indicates whether this CommandSource is enabled based on the environment configuration.
